# null-context (Data Source)

Computes `id` and `tags` for one resource from the provider defaults and/or a parent `context`. Inputs that share a name with an output (for example `name` or `tags`) are merged with the parent and returned normalized.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `additional_tag_map` (Map of String) Merged with the parent's; returned merged.
- `attributes` (List of String) Attributes appended to the parent's; returned normalized.
- `context` (Dynamic) Parent context: the `self` or `normalized_context` of another `context` data source (or the old module). When set, provider-level defaults are ignored.
- `delimiter` (String) Delimiter; returned with the default applied.
- `descriptor_formats` (Map of Object) Map of `{format, labels}` objects rendered into `descriptors`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--descriptor_formats))
- `dns_name_format` (String) Format of `dns_name`.
- `domain_name` (String) Domain used by `dns_name`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) False blanks `id`, `tags` and the normalized strings.
- `environment` (String) ID element; returned normalized.
- `id_length_limit` (Number) Returned with the default applied.
- `label_key_case` (String) `lower`, `title` or `upper`.
- `label_order` (List of String) Returned with the default applied.
- `label_value_case` (String) `lower`, `title`, `upper` or `none`.
- `labels_as_tags` (Set of String) ID elements to include as tags. First setting in a chain wins.
- `name` (String) ID element; returned normalized.
- `namespace` (String) ID element; returned normalized.
- `project` (String) ID element (not in the default `label_order`).
- `regex_replace_chars` (String) Returned with the default applied.
- `region` (String) ID element (not in the default `label_order`).
- `stage` (String) ID element; returned normalized.
- `tags` (Map of String) Extra tags merged over the parent's; returned as the final tag map.
- `tenant` (String) ID element; returned normalized.

### Read-Only

- `descriptors` (Map of String) Rendered `descriptor_formats`.
- `dns_name` (String) DNS name built from `dns_name_format`.
- `id` (String) Disambiguated ID, limited to `id_length_limit`.
- `id_full` (String) ID without the length limit.
- `legacy` (Dynamic) Cloud Posse compatible context.
- `normalized_context` (Dynamic) Normalized context to pass to child contexts (drops `project` and `region`, like the module).
- `self` (Dynamic) Merged raw inputs; the recommended value to pass as a child's `context`.
- `tags_as_list_of_maps` (List of Map of String) One map per tag with `key`, `value` and `additional_tag_map`.
